title: BioLegend Human IL-2 ELISA MAX Deluxe Set Protocol
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Configure robot parameters
steps.instruction: Select the ELISA step (coating, blocking, detection antibody, avidin‑HRP, TMB substrate, or stop), set the number of ELISA plates (1‑5), choose the reagent volume per well (100 µL or 200 µL), define the aspiration height in the reservoir (mm above the labware bottom), and decide whether to enable tip‑touch after dispense.

steps.title: Pause for off‑deck washing
steps.instruction: If off‑deck washing is required, command the 8‑channel P300 to move above the reagent reservoir and pause, allowing the user to complete washing steps before the robot continues.

steps.title: Dispense reagent to plates
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel P300, aspirate the selected volume (100 µL or 200 µL) from the reservoir at the defined height and dispense into the appropriate wells of each ELISA plate (1‑5 plates). Include tip‑touch after dispense if that option was enabled.
